Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4052680. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles, allowing nulls. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id.
